name: ABxLab
description: ABxLab is a framework for systematically studying how LLM-powered agents make decisions when faced with realistic consumer choices. It uses controlled A/B testing with manipulations of option attributes and persuasive cues in e-commerce browsing scenarios to assess agent susceptibility to factors that influence human choice behavior.
reputation: Accepted at ICLR 2026; novel approach to studying AI agent decision biases
notes: Built on AgentLab and BrowserGym frameworks; includes AgentXray visualization tool; supports multiple LLM providers; focuses on agent behavior rather than task competence.
